sn35.141:1.1: Cakkhum bhikkhave dukkhaṃ || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo cakkhussa uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūtam bhikkhave cakkhuṃ kuto sukham bhavissati || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā dukkhā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo jivhāya uppādāya kuto sukhā bhavissati || || Kāyo || pe || || Mano dukkho || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo manassa uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūto bhikkhave mano kuto sukho bhavissati || || Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
